description: The price of a session (a flat rate per person, all ages, charged in ISK), what every session includes, the optional print sizes with their prices, and gift-card validity. Other currencies are approximate references at the day's rate.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, CNY) shown as an approximate reference beside the price. The price itself is in ISK and is charged in ISK. Unknown codes are ignored.
